with open(CATALOG_CSV) as f:
    lines=f.readlines()
print("".join(lines[:5]))
print("total", len(lines))
import re
occ=[l for l in lines if "Occupancy" in l or "occupancy" in l]
print(len(occ))
print("".join(occ[:10]))

import csv
p1="49a712e6-9bdb-50ff-bf2e-5573d582bffc" # Perimeter_top_ZN_2
p2="b3f73bc4-684f-5295-a07e-c26b2b13702c" # DataCenter_top_ZN_6
date="2018-01-24"
start,end=8,18
d1={}
d2={}
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    r=csv.reader(f)
    hdr=next(r)
    for row in r:
        ts_id,ts,val=row[0],row[1],row[2]
        if ts_id not in (p1,p2): continue
        if not ts.startswith(date): continue
        # parse hour
        try:
            hh=int(ts[11:13])
        except:
            continue
        if hh<start or hh>end: continue
        try:
            v=float(val)
        except:
            continue
        if ts_id==p1: d1[hh]=v
        else: d2[hh]=v
print(sorted(d1.items()))
print(sorted(d2.items()))
m1=sum(d1.values())/len(d1)
m2=sum(d2.values())/len(d2)
print(m1,m2,m1-m2)
